_meta.description: Signal Registry — Maps patterns found in company-uploaded files to F3-Niche candidates. Agent scans all uploaded files, collects signals, scores each niche, and selects the highest-confidence match.

how_agent_uses_this.step_1: Scan every uploaded file: extract sheet names, column headers, file names, and sample data values
how_agent_uses_this.step_2: For each detected pattern, look it up in this registry → get niche_suggestions and weight
how_agent_uses_this.step_3: Sum weights per niche across all detected signals → produce niche scores
how_agent_uses_this.step_4: Apply against_signals: subtract weight if a contradicting signal is found
how_agent_uses_this.step_5: Normalize scores → pick niche with score above confidence_threshold (0.60 default)
how_agent_uses_this.step_6: Below threshold → trigger clarifying_questions for that ambiguous axis
how_agent_uses_this.step_7: Load the winning niche JSON and begin building company profile

signal_types.file_name: The name of the uploaded file itself
signal_types.column_header: Column header in any row of the file
signal_types.data_pattern: Pattern found in actual data values
signal_types.structural: How the file is shaped (multi-sheet, number of rows, etc.)

scoring_logic.description: Score = sum of weights of all detected signals for a niche, minus weights of against_signals detected
scoring_logic.normalization: Divide each niche score by max possible score for that niche to get 0–1 value
scoring_logic.tie_breaking: If two niches within 0.05 of each other → ask disambiguation question

file_name_signals.description: Patterns in the name of the uploaded file

rules.notes: Customer file = any business model. Low discriminating power alone.
Any item file = not a pure service business
BOM file = strong manufacturer signal
Production file = manufacturer. Very high weight.
Multiple warehouses signals trading/distribution more than manufacturing at SME scale
Expiry tracking = food/pharma/perishable = food batch niche
Invoice file alone is low signal — almost everyone has one

column_header_signals.description: Column headers detected in any spreadsheet. Most discriminating signal type.

rules.notes: Component/raw material column = BOM existence = manufacturer. Very high weight.
Serial tracking can appear in auto parts, electronics. Moderate weight.
Variants could be garment (size+color) or hardware (size+grade). Needs disambiguation from other signals.
GSTIN = B2B India business. Eliminates pure B2C and very small informal businesses.
Credit terms = B2B trading. Rarely in food batch manufacturing or services.
HSN = goods, SAC = services. If SAC present → service_professional signal
Multiple location management = larger trading operation
Reorder management = high SKU volume trading. Auto parts and FMCG distributors typically manage this.
Hardware items often have grade/size but no manufacturing
Route-based selling is typical of FMCG distribution
MRP/PTR/PTD pricing structure is typical of FMCG channel

data_value_signals.description: Patterns detected in the actual data values (not just headers). Agent samples first 100 rows.

rules.pattern: GSTIN format: 2-digit state code + 10-char PAN + 1 entity + Z + 1 check (e.g. 27AABCU9603R1ZX)
rules.notes: GSTIN = registered B2B India business. Confirms India + B2B axis.

rules.pattern: High item count: more than 500 unique items detected
rules.notes: 500+ SKUs = high-volume trading. Auto parts and FMCG distributors typically have large catalogs.

rules.pattern: Low item count: fewer than 50 unique items detected
rules.notes: Fewer than 50 items = service or job shop (custom) or narrow product range manufacturer

rules.pattern: Item names with size suffix: e.g. 'Shirt-S', 'Shirt-M', 'Shirt-L', 'Shirt-XL'
Item names with pipe/grade pattern: e.g. '20mm GI Pipe', '1inch MS Pipe Class B'
Item names with part number pattern: e.g. 'TVS-2345', 'Hero-98765', 'BRNG-6205'
Dates in future or far past in 'expiry' or 'best before' column
Invoice amounts are round numbers with no stock movement (only service lines)
Tax column has only 'SAC' codes (starts with 99)
Multiple rows for same customer with small order amounts (e.g. <500 per line)
rules.notes: High-frequency small-ticket orders = FMCG distributor pattern

rules.pattern: Job/order number column where each order has unique customer+unique spec
rules.notes: Every order is different = job shop

rules.pattern: All invoices to same 5-10 customers repeating every month
rules.notes: Retainer/recurring billing pattern = professional services

rules.pattern: Negative quantity rows in stock file
rules.suggests_data_issue: allow_negative_stock = on in current system → process maturity low → flag in context profile
rules.notes: Not a niche signal — but IS a context profile flag. Company has stock discipline problems.

rules.pattern: MRP column with values higher than selling price column
Multiple price columns for same item (e.g. 'Dealer Price', 'Retailer Price', 'MRP')
rules.notes: Multi-tier pricing = price list feature needed in ERPNext

sheet_name_signals.description: Signals from Excel workbook tab names

clarifying_questions.description: When agent confidence is below threshold, ask these questions to disambiguate. Keyed by the axis that is ambiguous.

business_model_ambiguous.trigger: manufacturing vs trading score within 0.05 of each other
business_model_ambiguous.question: Does your company manufacture or produce anything? (Even simple assembly or packing counts)
options: No, we only buy and sell

garment_vs_food_ambiguous.question: What type of products do you manufacture?

trading_type_ambiguous.trigger: trading niches within 0.05 of each other
trading_type_ambiguous.question: Which best describes your products?
options: FMCG, grocery, or daily use consumer goods
Hardware, pipes, tiles, or building materials
Auto parts, spares, or machinery components

service_vs_trading_ambiguous.trigger: service_professional and any trading niche within 0.05
service_vs_trading_ambiguous.question: Do you maintain any physical inventory or stock?
options: Yes, we keep stock and ship goods
No, we provide only services (consulting, labor, software)

size_confirmation.trigger: always ask to set context profile
size_confirmation.question: Approximately how many people work in your business?

current_system_confirmation.trigger: always ask to set context profile
current_system_confirmation.question: What software do you currently use to manage accounts or inventory?

context_profile_flags.description: These are NOT niche signals — they go into the Context Profile as data quality and process maturity indicators

flags.trigger: Negative quantities found in any stock file
flags.meaning: Company runs on negative stock — allow_negative_stock was enabled. Opening stock data will be unreliable.
flags.action: Set context_profile.stock_data_quality = poor. Flag for manual stock count before go-live.

flags.trigger: Same item name appears with different codes, or same code appears with different names
flags.meaning: Item master is messy. High data cleanup effort required.
flags.action: Set context_profile.item_master_quality = poor. Estimate 2–3x extra time for item master cleanup.

flags.trigger: HSN Code column is empty or absent in item file
flags.meaning: GST compliance gap. All invoices will fail e-invoicing / GSTR filing.
flags.action: Set context_profile.gstin_compliance_risk = high. Add HSN mapping as mandatory pre-go-live task.

flags.trigger: Customer file has GSTIN column but many blank values
flags.meaning: ITC risk for their customers. Also indicates unregistered dealers in customer base.

flags.trigger: Niche is a manufacturer but no BOM/component/recipe file was uploaded
flags.meaning: Company does not have documented BOMs. Must be built from scratch.
flags.action: Set context_profile.bom_status = missing. Add BOM discovery session as mandatory step. This is a blocker for Work Orders.

flags.trigger: Multiple city/branch/location names appear as distinct values in stock files
flags.action: Set context_profile.warehouse_count = multiple. Enable multi-warehouse in ERPNext setup.

flags.trigger: File contains 'Tally' in file name, or has typical Tally export structure (Opening Balance / Closing Balance columns, Narration column)
flags.meaning: Company is on Tally. Accounts and ledger data will be well-structured. Stock data may be unreliable.
flags.action: Set context_profile.current_system = tally. Use Tally COA for account mapping. Prioritize ledger migration.

flags.trigger: Transaction dates older than 5 years present in files
flags.meaning: Company uploaded historical data. Only import recent fiscal year(s) to avoid system bloat.
flags.action: Set context_profile.data_scope = historical_included. Confirm migration scope with company.

flags.trigger: 80%+ of invoice rows are for same 1–3 customers
flags.meaning: Company is highly dependent on few clients — high revenue concentration risk.
flags.action: Set context_profile.customer_concentration = high. Note as business risk in company profile.

key_discriminating_signals: high customer count with small orders
project list + batch register both present
coating product names (epoxy, PU, vinyl ester)
